title: Split on Paragraphs, Not Overlap
briefMd:
# Phase 2 · Split on Paragraphs, Not Overlap

The benefits FAQ answers every question in one paragraph of two sentences: the rule, then its condition ("The bike lease lets you lease a bike of up to three thousand euros through your salary. The lease runs for three years, and you can buy the bike for ten percent at the end."). A question counts only when both sentences sit in one retrieved chunk.

The paragraphs are 120 to 390 characters long, so whatever size you pick, a chunk boundary lands inside some answer. Overlap repairs that by repeating text, and every repeated sentence is paid for again in the context.

You control **chunk size**, **overlap** and **split strategy**. Retrieval is BM25, top 5 chunks, and all five go into the context.

**Gates:** recall@5 ≥ 0.90 and mean context tokens (top-5 chunks) ≤ 340 on the hidden set.
